descriptions.tsonnet_c30_dvd_open_80218c50: Initializes a file object through the base routine, sets its handle fields to -1 and 0, and unless bit 1 of the flags is set converts the path to a DVD entry number, opens it into the embedded info record, stores the success flag and logs 'DVDOpen: path ok/fail!'; returns 0 on success or when the flag is set and 0x90000004 on failure. Field meanings are inferred.
